nom: haruharu Black Rice Probiotics Barrier Essence

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin, including one who also has larger pores, report the essence hydrates without adding shine, sits well under makeup and doesn't leave an oily look.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, very dry or post-menopausal dry skin consistently report deep, lasting hydration and softer, smoother skin, often becoming a favorite over other milky toners they'd tried.
segments.combination: Reports conflict: one reviewer with combination skin says it caused breakouts and worsened her texture, while another with combination skin says it hydrates well without causing any pimples.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers, including some with rosacea or a history of over-exfoliation, report calm, soothed, less reactive skin with no irritation; one reviewer who says she isn't usually sensitive to products developed red bumps and seborrheic dermatitis on two separate uses.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature or perimenopausal/postmenopausal skin report a stronger-feeling barrier, plumper and more resilient skin, and reduced pore appearance; one reviewer with dry, mature skin says it falls a bit short specifically for mature skin, though it still works well for her overall.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report plumper, firmer-looking skin, improved elasticity and reduced pore appearance, with one noting diminished dark spots and using it on her hands to look younger; one reviewer with mature skin feels it falls a little short on anti-aging specifically, even though she likes it otherwise.
concerns.dehydration: This is the most consistently reported benefit: reviewers across skin types describe deep, lasting hydration and softer skin from the first use, with no reviewer reporting a failure to hydrate (one reviewer with acne-prone skin found it too moisturizing for her needs).
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including ones with rosacea or reactive skin from professional laser treatments, report reduced redness and calmer skin; one reviewer, however, developed red bumps and seborrheic dermatitis from the product on two separate occasions.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the essence as strengthening a stressed or compromised skin barrier, including after professional laser treatments or heavy actives use, with skin feeling calmer and more resilient within one to two weeks.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports that red and dark spots on her face visibly diminished starting the first day of use.
concerns.blemishes: Reports conflict: several reviewers with acne-prone or combination skin say it never clogs pores or causes breakouts and even reduces stress-related breakouts, while two others, including one with acne-prone skin and one with combination skin, say it broke them out.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or shine-prone skin report the essence hydrates without adding grease or shine, sitting well under makeup without an oily look by midday.

aspects.libelle: Milky, lightweight texture, absorbs fast without stickiness
Feels slightly sticky during initial adjustment

extraits.titre: Gave Me Red Bumps and Dermatitis
extraits.texte: It caused red bumps all over my face—seborrheic dermatitis. I’m not usually sensitive to products, but I tried it twice already and the same thing happened both times. As soon as I stop using it, my skin goes back to normal. Unfortunately, I’m already past the return period, so now I’m stuck with a useless product on my vanity.
It’s too moisturizing, but if you have acne-prone skin, this not is for you, I have acne skin and broke me.😔 Even so, it continues been a good moisturizer milk for dry skin NO acne prone.
No es definitiva la puntuación. Llevo dos semanas usándolo y me ha sacado brotes y textura. No lo recomiendo para piel mixta

extraits.titre: Exceptional Barrier Essence for Layering — Hydrating, Soothing, and Perfect for Mature SkinExceptional Barrier Essence f
extraits.texte: I’m 52 with post-menopausal skin that tends to be drier and more sensitive than it used to be, so barrier support and hydration are extremely important in my routine. I’ve been using Korean skincare for many years and have tried countless essences, toners, and barrier products, but this one from Haruharu Wonder has quickly become one of my favorites for strengthening and maintaining the skin barrier. This essence is exactly the kind of product that works beautifully for that purpose. The texture is lightweight but very cushioning at the same time. It absorbs easily without feeling watery or thin, and it gives the skin that comfortable, hydrated feel that lasts rather than disappearing a few minutes later. It layers exceptionally well, which makes it ideal for the Korean skincare method of “skin flooding” or applying multiple hydrating layers. One of the things I appreciate most about this formula is how calming it is. When my skin feels a little stressed, dry, or reactive, this helps restore balance quickly. The probiotics and black rice extract seem to work together to support the skin barrier while improving overall skin resilience. After applying it, my skin feels noticeably softer and more supple. There’s a healthy glow that comes from well-hydrated skin, but it doesn’t leave any sticky or heavy residue. That’s important because I use several serums and creams afterward, and this never interferes with the rest of my routine. Over time I’ve also noticed that my skin looks

Ok...so I usually don't do reviews, but I HAVE to for this one! I have been looking for something to plump my skin because I am 40 and I am desperately trying to avoid LOOKING my age haha. I have only used this a couple of times, but my forehead is looking PORELESS. I looked in the mirror last night and was like wait a minute!! I do have combo/oily skin with larger pores on my cheeks - those are smaller too. I love how affordable this is too. I was contemplating the Rhode, but I just couldn't bring myself to spend the money on it being this was the first milky toner I've tried. It didn't break my bank to add to my already expensive skincare routine. I do tox my forehead, but something was missing to give it that flawless look, and this did it! It isn't greasy at all - just purely hydrated! So far, it sits very well under makeup and I don't look like an oil slick by noon. I will keep using this to see what happens in a couple of weeks, but this is already promising!

extraits.titre: Holy grail for dry and sensitive skin- ? still on the fence, fall into this face first
extraits.texte: I get the hype now, my skin has never looked healthier from a single product, this essence made my dry, dull and sensitive skin behave again! It's feels so soothing and is made for rough stressed skin that needs extra support when using actives.! My skin is less reactive, less red and have had less breaks outs due to environmental stress. It’s rich and luxurios and absorbs in seconds, leaving a silky finish (not greasy). For me it works especially well with my base makeup. My concealer and blush melts into my skin for that “your skin but better” look.
